tasks.instruction: Summarize records.json into summary.json. Include only rows with absent status or status equal to posted after strip/casefold. Normalize category using strip/casefold and use uncategorized for blank or missing categories. Parse finite numeric amounts, numeric strings with grouping commas, optional leading $, €, or £, and accounting parentheses for negatives. Skip null, booleans, empty, invalid, and nonfinite amounts. Count accepted rows including zero; sum exactly and round final category totals to two decimals using ROUND_HALF_UP. Output {"count": integer, "totals": {category: "two-decimal amount"}} as JSON.
